title: Kestrel (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Kestrel is a small, fast Teladi scout with one forward gun. Its main tools are the scan and long-range scan modes on the left hat.

panels.name: Kestrel: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Kestrel that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Kestrel are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The Kestrel is flown from a cockpit seat, as small and medium ships are. The pilot sits here and has all the controls of this guide.
controls.context: From this seat the pilot sees the HUD, the radar and the monitors of the Kestrel.

controls.name: Forward gun
controls.text: The Kestrel has one forward gun that point where the nose points. The pilot fires them with the trigger and aims by turning the whole ship.
controls.context: The aiming mark in front of the target on the HUD shows where to point the nose.

controls.name: Scanner
controls.text: The Kestrel is a scout. Its most important tools are scan mode and long-range scan mode, which find and reveal objects and hidden signals.
controls.context: Both modes are on the left hat: right for scan mode, left for long-range scan.
